title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode4 Let Us Be Friends!

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: An actual raid?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe that wasn't the best way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My goal is to use the raid in the beginning to raise the excitement level for the show. That's why I'd like for it to be as real as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
But how do we do that exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing at the plaza in front of the museum, no? I noticed that a handful of lamp posts line the area.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can use those to signal the start of the attack. Specifically, I'm thinking about having the commander stand on top of them as they give the order.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: On top of them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've already received permission from the museum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lamps are wide and flat on top, so it's actually possible to stand on top of them. I'm planning on making a prop for support that can be attached to one's lower back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, they're about five meters tall, so we'll also need to prepare a lifeline and safety mats just in case the worst happens.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Five meters...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
...
Okay, can we test that out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Test it out?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Yes, a test is a good idea!
Let's see... Oh, that gate over there seems to be about five meters high.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Emu, can we try climbing on top of that gate over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, no problem!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Alright, let's tie this lifeline onto you and... You're all set to climb!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Okay...
Asahi, mind reading the line before mine for me?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Sure!
The security guard's line, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They seem pretty used to doing stuff like this...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Intruders!! All hands on deck!!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “They must be after the androids in the underground laboratory, Alfred and Bartlett!! Whoa!!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Geez, they've already made it this far...!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“The laboratory is ours!
However, we don't appear to be alone...”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“No matter...
Professor Christopher Hawking! Surrender and bring those androids of yours to us at once!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, that was so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm staggered...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a little dangerous, but I do agree that orders sound more compelling when literally given from up high!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But we'll be in full view of the audience as we climb. We didn't exactly look cool while we did, so we should think of a way to cover for that.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We'll also want to look cool while dropping down. Remember those poles we used during that one show? What if we used them for this scene?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: Okay, let's ask to see if we can borrow them from the theater!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So this is what ArcLand's cast members are capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even if a stunt is clearly dangerous, they're willing to consider the value in it instead of outright deciding against it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but they're able to come up with ways to improve and implement it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've never experienced anything like this before...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Okay, Rui, that should allow us to implement your idea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
With regards to this stunt, I'd like to keep polishing it while receiving input from all of you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Alright, sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, let's begin practicing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What is the meaning of this?
Where are the laboratory's security guards?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Again, Tsukasa, you're an android!
You sound far too shaken! Act more robotic!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I understand that it's an emotional scene, but it may be better to not give each word so much weight. Try saying your lines like you're saying A-E-I-O-U.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Let me try that again.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Sergeant Willis!
Have you apprehended the Professor?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“We still can't find him...
There's no sign of him in the lab!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Am I right in saying that you're more the stationary type, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes...
Compared to the others, I don't tend to move around all that much...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I see. Then, let's try going over the scene where we're looking for the Professor together. We're soldiers, so we need to look the part.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if we did something like this when we burst in through the doors?! Ka-pow!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, that looks fun!
Lemme try it too! Ka-pow!!
se_event_curtaincall_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That was so cool!! How did you manage to go all twirly-whirly?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. It's supposed to be a trade secret... But if you really wanna know...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I do! Please teach me!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work, Nene.
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tired... I've been using all my energy just to keep up with the others. They're too good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they've also been giving me some advice here and there, which is really nice. Still, it's amazing how they can pull off all these crazy stunts. It's like they're all Seiryuin.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (ArcLand's cast members are certainly very skilled.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Some are definitely as good as Seiryuin, the prima donna of the Phoenix Stage. On top of that, they have Asahi, who's in a league of his own.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was afraid that the others would feel somewhat dejected when faced with such a skill gap...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But they seem to be taking it in stride...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about how to act out this part.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: During the raid, Alfred becomes unable to walk after being shot in the foot, right?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Since we'll be performing our show at a big plaza, I'm wondering if our audience will be able to actually see me if I'm on all fours... I'm thinking that we ask Rui to set up some sort of platform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
By the way, how do you plan to play him during that scene?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, something like this.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Bartlett...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “I cannot move any further... Go on without me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I thought this when his fellow cast member climbed on top of the gate...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But Asahi and them all make full use of body language in their performances. It's a far cry from our abilities.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only do they have a deep understanding of their roles, but they can get into character at the snap of a finger. Even something as difficult as being an android...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Furthermore, despite being an emotionless android, he's able to make each scene incredibly impactful.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if we're on a real battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Such acting talent...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, we practiced so much today!
I'm super tired!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see why. We're dealing with roles that are more difficult than usual and involve quite a bit more action.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a result, my stomach is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whose stomach just growled...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa, that wasn't you?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought it was you too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nonsense!
Yes, I'm hungry, but...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh... P-Pardon my indiscretion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was you, Asahi...?!
How is your stomach able to produce such a violent sound?!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Um, so... I get hungry somewhat easily...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hey, I know!
Why don't we go out and grab some dinner?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Does that mean we get to eat food from the same plate?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really hope you didn't take that literally...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha! That's the general idea!
And since I suggested it, I'll pay!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, let's take this opportunity to dine and chat! Okay, to be fair, I was thinking that we go to a diner or something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This may be our chance to learn some things that we can't necessarily while on stage...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, just give us a second to let our parents know!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes! That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? W-We're really going?
I'm not sure if I feel confident enough for that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We shouldn't let this opportunity slip. Not when it means we may get to ask them about how they usually practice and such.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Right...
We don't get many chances like this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna go too!
Let's have a big feast!!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How about you, Rui? Will you be able to join us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'd also like to go.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's celebrate this wonderful union between us and the cast members of ArcLand...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is this? A wedding toast?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's dig in! This all looks so good♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you'll burn your tongue if you're not careful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be careful!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Hehe. Your Salisbury steak looks delicious, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Now, today was the first rehearsal where we all used our scripts... How did everyone do in your guys' opinion?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, we were very impressed by ArcLand's cast members. You certainly are a world-class bunch...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On top of being wonderful actors, you're willing to listen to others and provide suggestions for improvement in order to make the show as good as it can be. I couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...
And we all seemed to learn quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Practicing with all of you made me realize that I still have a lot of work to do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's so much that I still don't know... If I'm going to have any hope of becoming a world-famous star, I'll need to keep learning as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, don't worry about me!
I plan on using this experience to soar to even greater heights.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since working with such skilled actors means we get to learn new things from one another. So, I hope we get to keep doing that until the curtains go up on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Of course! I'd like that as well!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, there's actually something that I've been meaning to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Is it just me or is your directing style heavily influenced by Tom Gray?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What...?
Yes, that's right. How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I knew it!
The way you had us do the raid scene today reminded me of the heist scene from “Acclamation of Anger”.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get what you're talking about! The way he made things more dramatic by drawing the viewer's eyes up was so Tom Gray.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I've seen all of Tom Gray's shows at least a hundred times!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, we get that you're a huge fanatic. But I get the feeling that you're also a pretty big fan, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I am...
I suspect that I've also seen all his shows about that many times.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, my comrade!
No matter how many times I see the shows he directed, I can never get tired of them! Am I right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean.
I was particularly taken aback by how “Acclamation of Anger” pays homage to three of his other works.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Wait, three?
I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Do you want to become a director like Tom Gray, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Just like him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I want to keep making those kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's what he said during an interview...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling that you knew.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Of course. I mean, what he said really hit home with me!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I had the honor of hearing Tom tell me that in person...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: There was a time when I lived abroad because of my parents' work, but we somehow found ourselves in the middle of a conflict.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A conflict...?!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: This may be hard to believe, but we suddenly began hearing gunfire. Before long, my windows were being shot out...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It was so scary.
My heart still races every time I think about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That reminds me of...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a hidden gem in terms of science-fiction stories. A friend of mine recommended it to me and read it for the first time at a library in Japan when I was in sixth grade.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now I see. What he really meant was...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if we're on a real battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's his lived experience...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, as my parents and I were trying to flee, I got separated from them...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I didn't know what to do, but this old lady helped me out by giving me a ride in her car... As luck would have it, I was able to make it to the border.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I felt better after I saw that there were a lot of people waiting there, but that wasn't the end of it...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I didn't really know the local language since I was only in elementary school, and I hadn't heard any news about my parents. I really thought the world was ending.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That was when I met Tom Gray.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What was he doing there?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: He was from the neighboring country and was volunteering to help refugees.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I had no idea who he was.
But when he tried to hand me some bread, I said, "I don't want that. I want a way to not be alone."

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, he suddenly stood up and replied, “Now is the perfect time to put on a show for children such as yourself.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It was incredible. Alongside his volunteering duties, he somehow made costumes, props and even a stage out of the refuse and rubble that was lying around. After that, he made reflectors out of the pull tabs he'd taken off some cans and hung them from the roof. I remember how shiny they were.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The show he did was about a child who'd become separated from everyone due to war and how these strange animals took care of him until he was able to reunite with his parents...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It was so fun and exciting.
I almost thought that it was about me...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It really felt like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And thanks to Tom's show, I was able to find my parents.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: All because this photo of a certain child who looked completely entranced by his performance was printed in a newspaper.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That sounds like an unforgettable memory...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It is!
After all, Tom's my hero!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That was when I decided that I wanted to work in show business, and began studying to become an actor...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, I learned about ArcLand and the Center Theatre.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'd already had some interest in ArcLand since it was famous for being a theme park that put on world-class shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I came up with the idea of putting on shows at the Center Theatre that bring the world together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. I guess that needs more explaining...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In other words, ArcLand is currently working to do shows like the one Tom showed me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: For all those people out there who are somehow surviving but are unable to smile...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The cast of the Center Theatre plans to do shows around the world just for them.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Right now, we're sort of trying to build the foundation for that. Our goal is to perform at venues all over Japan.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Once we've accomplished that, we want to travel around the world putting on charity shows and volunteer events.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We know that not everywhere is safe, and we're trying our best to get a full understanding of that. But we want to do this.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, in order to produce shows that transcend borders, we need to start by putting on shows in as many places as we can!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Members
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I see...
Asahi and the others have the same dream as me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But they're much closer to achieving it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
I can't help but feel somewhat anxious.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I think I'm so enamored with your directing style, Rui, because you also look up to Tom. I mean, you guys' night show was just so spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We appreciate your kind words.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But to think that you're still in high school. Yes, Tom's clearly had a big effect on you, but it's obvious that you've also developed your own style.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
Of course he has!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you acting all high and mighty about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But Rui really is amazing!
All his ideas always go BANG-ZOOM-BOOM!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
He definitely likes throwing in some flashy effects.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I know!
Why don't you come join us and become our director?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Whoa! Slow down!
You can't go asking the director of another troupe to just up and leave!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, I was joking!
I couldn't help it. He's just such a good director...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really had us going there!
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This sort of banter is nice every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (It is meant in jest...)
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But I think it'd be really fun if you did join us.
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002
